description: Iris, India's first AI-generated school teacher robot, was unveiled at a grand event in a Kerala school by Makerlabs Edutech.
body_lead: Iris, India’s first AI-generated school teacher robot, was unveiled at a grand event in a Kerala school by Makerlabs Edutech. The groundbreaking innovation opens the possibilities of generative artificial intelligence in education. Read here to learn more. A school in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala has unveiled a groundbreaking innovation in education with the introduction of India’s first Generative Artificial Intelligence teacher robot named ‘Iris’.
